messages:
Linora Vega: Reminder: company all-hands this Friday 11:00 PT (Zoom). Short agenda: 1) Exec update + hiring snapshot (7m) 2) Dedicated GA launch highlights + migration checklist (10m) 3) Data retention defaults update (4m) 4) Runtime batching demo + perf win (8m) 5) Product roadmap micro-update (5m) 6) Live AMA (20m). Please add any questions here or to the intake form: https://forms.gle/ri-intake. Slides due Thu EOD. Recording link will be posted to #all-hands-recordings.

OpsBot: Calendar event created — 2026-02-20 11:00 PT. Reminders set for 24h and 15m before.


Diego Ramos: I'll cover Dedicated GA highlights. Plan to include migration checklist and an example customer migration timeline (2-3 weeks). Also want a 3-minute slot to run through rollback steps in the demo.


Naomi Ito: I'll present the data retention change: default retention for standard tenants will move to 30 days; enterprise tenants keep configurable retention. Legal confirmed notice copy; Product will send a 7-day heads-up email to affected customers.


Linora Vega: Good. @Diego please sync with Support on migration cadence and make sure the KB is ready. @Naomi add the exact email text into the shared slide notes.


Diego Ramos: Will do. Demo plan: run continuous batching vs legacy at typical seq lengths. Quick command I'll use in demo: `rdw bench --model redwood-xl --batching=continuous --seq=512 --concurrency=100`


Naomi Ito: Accessibility: enable Zoom captions and upload VTT with the recording. Also we'll attach a short FAQ covering pricing / SLA / retention opt-outs.


PeopleOps: Reminder: slides due Thu 5pm PT so we can stitch timestamps and speaker names into the recording notes.


Linora Vega: Thanks all — final slides to this thread by Thu 5pm PT. If you can't make the rehearsal, drop a short recorded audio clip and we'll play it during the dry run. See you Friday!"
